pending.title: Duotone Ghost Portrait Composite
pending.prompt: A layered composite portrait of the person in the photo, featuring a massive close-up duotone ghost portrait on the left within a large circular blue backdrop shape, and a smaller sharp full-color full-body walking portrait on the right, both set against a plain light-grey background. The ghost portrait shows a close-up of the person with their head angled slightly downward, slicked-back voluminous hair, wearing aviator-style sunglasses, a full moustache, and a light beard, softly blended within a large solid blue circle. The foreground subject shows a full-body walking pose, walking forward with one hand tucked in a trouser pocket, the other arm relaxed near the waist, head turned slightly to the side, with a calm composed expression. The subject has a medium-tan skin tone, a lean build, and wears an [OUTFIT_COLOR: cream-white] linen blazer over a matching light cream button-up shirt unbuttoned at the collar, matching cream tailored trousers, and black leather lace-up dress shoes. Use soft even studio lighting from the front, a [COLOR_GRADE: cool blue-grey duotone and warm natural] color grade, and a clean editorial aesthetic. Keep the person's face and identity unchanged in both the background portrait and the foreground figure, preserving their exact facial structure, hairstyle, facial features, and natural appearance exactly as shown in the photo.
